scope: Design-phase research and review for the proposed web-surface architecture. No web-engine runtime, credential transfer or application implementation was exercised. Earlier source-browser path/attribute observations are dated and do not qualify engine/import behavior; September 30 public metadata/header checks are recorded separately.
sanitization: Generic filesystem templates and public source references only; no per-machine names, account IDs, credential values, private transcripts or user-specific absolute paths.

repository_baseline.method: Read-only exploration of a working tree on branch fix/quality-correctness on 2026-09-29; load-bearing claims re-verified against origin/main at f9ab786 before the docs/web-surface-architecture branch (attention State constructor, transport version 6, AttachMode::join, process-group guard note, check scripts).
repository_baseline.no_existing_web_engine: Zero occurrences of QWebEngine/WKWebView/CEF/WebKit in apps/, services/, adapters/, tools/ source and build files.
repository_baseline.adapter_extension_point: attention::State is constructed with (session_id, adapter_id); a web surface can register as a new adapter source without contract changes. attention.hpp:63 on main f9ab786 (:61 on the surveyed branch tree).
repository_baseline.terminal_wire_protocol: Version 6, cell-typed end to end (TerminalSnapshot over local socket; GUI rasterizes via QSGTextNode; no texture or image channel exists). services/session/src/transport/local_protocol.hpp:9.
repository_baseline.process_model: Existing session services are detached per agent, but the macOS 27 investigation invalidates GUI-detached spawning as a durability guarantee. Web-service birth and registry ownership depend on the R1/R4 persistent launchd supervisor.
repository_baseline.join_precedent: AttachMode::join with bounded views (phone gateway) is the structural precedent for additional attachment kinds.

engine_landscape.verified_from: Surveyed documentation plus distribution metadata; no engine runtime was exercised. September 30 review also fetched the candidate branch cef_browser.h for in-process DevTools API declarations.

cef.verdict: Selected candidate from the survey. Its paint/input and in-process DevTools APIs fit the proposal; W0 must prove the required behavior, including macOS offscreen delivery.
cef.injection: No native userscript API; deterministic injection via CDP Page.addScriptToEvaluateOnNewDocument ('in every frame upon creation, before any frame script executes'), optionally in a named isolated world.
cef.license: CEF BSD terms plus independent Chromium third-party obligations; no blanket copyleft clearance. Inventory/SBOM and notices are release gates.
cef.watch: Verify maintenance/security-update support against primary release evidence at each pin decision; unsupported governance rumors are not gates.

wkwebview.verdict: Display candidate; public user scripts and snapshots exist, but continuous frame delivery and headless input for this design were not qualified. Missing evidence does not prove those integrations impossible.
wkwebview.watch: WKProcessPool deprecated in Safari 26.0 (September 2025); replacement process-sharing model undocumented.

qt_webengine.verdict: Direct QML embedding couples lifetime to the desktop. A separate supervised Qt host is a possible alternative whose headless/frame/input contracts need a probe.
qt_webengine.license: Qt parts LGPLv3/GPL/commercial; bundled Chromium third-party includes LGPL 2.1 components.

rejected.playwright_webkit: Not selected as an embedding API for an existing WKWebView. Playwright Chromium CDP attach support is a separate capability and is not excluded by this claim.
rejected.servo: Not selected; site-compatibility and embedding claims require qualification rather than a survey-wide readiness verdict.

cef_distribution_verification.method: Fetched the distribution index directly and enumerated macosarm64 entries (9.9 MB JSON, parsed locally).
cef_distribution_verification.result: Candidate macosarm64 stable Chromium 154.0.8037.58 is present in the current index; minimal archive is 132224904 bytes (about 126.1 MiB).
cef_distribution_verification.significance: Distribution metadata establishes an available candidate, not a runtime pin. W0 still needs archive fetch, independent digest, SDK/deployment inspection and runtime qualification.

injection_determinism.model: Declarative service-owned bootstrap registration is the reliability precedent. JavaScript world isolation does not isolate the DOM, establish health or intercept main-world history APIs.
modern_equivalents: CDP Page.addScriptToEvaluateOnNewDocument is a candidate target/frame registration mechanism. Renderer replacement, OOPIF attachment and reconnect require acknowledgement/reconciliation; persistence across those boundaries is a W1 test, not a survey guarantee.
WKUserScript atDocumentStart in a WKContentWorld: persists in the WKUserContentController and re-injects on every load.
QWebEngineScript DocumentCreation on a profile: applies to every page load in the profile.
Electron preload with contextIsolation: same per-new-document contract.
edge_cases: Soft SPA routes do not create a new document. Use host navigation events and snapshot diffs; any required main-world history hook is page-visible, tamperable and advisory.
bfcache restores resume the same document; detect via pageshow persisted.
about:blank/srcdoc are new documents and can double-inject; scripts must be idempotent.
Service workers are never injected by these mechanisms; out of scope for v1.
lapis owns matching rules for its proposed bootstrap; native extension/userscript matching mechanisms are not ruled out across every engine.

pain_inventory_highlights: Profile locks: 'A persistent profile can only be used by one browser instance at a time' (playwright-mcp README).
State leaks: orphaned Chrome at ppid=1 (chrome-devtools-mcp #2621); browser-use leaked 7741 temp dirs / 14 GB (#5422).
Launch flakiness under tool-call timeouts: chrome-devtools-mcp #1914, #2778, #2675; browser-use macOS keychain hang #5415.
Ref invalidation: refs valid only until the next page change (playwright.dev/mcp/snapshots).
No cleanup hook: agents cannot close the launched browser (chrome-devtools-mcp #484).
control_contract_basis.capability_ranking: Snapshot read, navigate, click, type/fill, wait, screenshot are the core loop; network interception and downloads are rare but exactly the risky classes needing approval gating.
control_contract_basis.snapshot_representation: Refs carry a provenance snapshot hash, a semantic target fingerprint and view/epoch/navigation scope. Only unambiguous unchanged targets within the same navigation generation can move; approvals bind current target and arguments. Raw eval/CDP remain unavailable in v1.

prior_art_verdicts.embedded_vs_external: Trust-driven split: real-login agents attach to external browsers (Claude in Chrome extension, Cline CDP attach); dev-state agents embed views (Cursor 2.0 in-editor browser, Windsurf Wave 10). lapis targets the embedded quadrant with a service-owned lifetime neither product has.
dead_ends: Several surveyed tools prefer refs/index actions; this does not establish that all coordinate/vision approaches have been replaced.
VS Code Simple Browser as a platform: five years of unfixable gaps (no copy/paste #182011, no modals #185204, no video #289795) because it never got engine-level integration.
Zed embedded webview: wry-backed PR closed unmerged (zed-industries/zed#54433).
Electron <webview> preload injection as a determinism core: documented stability and security gaps.
prior_art_verdicts.multi_instance: One engine tree with many contexts is the proposed measured baseline; profile locks require explicit sharing/isolation policy but do not by themselves prove that all alternatives are impossible.
prior_art_verdicts.macos_volatility: wry #1778: macOS 26 blocked cross-scheme subresource loads overnight; custom-scheme designs need per-release probes.

session_import.status: Design-phase source survey, not a fresh credential-read or transfer experiment. W4 must pin source schemas, context mapping, retention and platform authorization behavior.
session_import.architecture: Explicit user consent for the source profile, selected origins and destination precedes protected-store access/decryption. Read a consistent source snapshot, validate, then inject through host-owned engine APIs into the destination in-memory context. Reimport is never scheduled silently.

chromium_family.store: ~/Library/Application Support/<Vendor>/<App>/<Profile>/Cookies; SQLite schema v24 (kCurrentVersionNumber=24, sqlite_persistent_cookie_store.cc); rollback-journal (no WAL); copy Cookies plus Cookies-journal, or sqlite3_backup from a read-only connection.
chromium_family.encryption: v10 || AES-128-CBC; key = PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA1(1003 iterations, password=<Brand> Safe Storage keychain item, salt 'saltysalt'); fixed IV of 16 space bytes. App-bound encryption (v20) is Windows-only; macOS unchanged in current main through Chromium 154-era code.
chromium_family.v24_trap: The surveyed v24 source adds a host-key digest prefix that must be verified before accepting plaintext. Recheck the pinned source version and any importer version; do not infer current third-party library behavior from an old release date.
chromium_family.keychain_ux: The prior survey reported an attributes-only Safe Storage lookup. That does not qualify secret access, ACL prompts, unlock state or persistent grants. W4 must measure actual operator-consented access under the application signing identity.
chromium_family.session_cookies: Recoverability depends on source version, settings, memory-only data and session-restore state. A cookie DB is not a complete browser-session snapshot.

firefox.store: cookies.sqlite is a surveyed source with version-dependent schema/journaling and originAttributes. Pin and snapshot it consistently; do not assume it includes all in-memory/session-restore cookies.

safari.store: The survey reported the macOS 26 app-container Cookies.binarycookies path. Recheck format, access permissions and supported metadata after consent; transferability is unmeasured.

session_import.cdp_export_dead_end: Chrome 136+ (March 2025) ignores --remote-debugging-port/--remote-debugging-pipe on the default user-data-dir because remote debugging was the top cookie-exfiltration vector; export requires a dedicated user-data-dir. developer.chrome.com/blog/remote-debugging-port.
session_import.injection: Storage.setCookies {cookies: Network.CookieParam[], browserContextId} browser-level before first navigation; map samesite -1->omit, 0->None, 1->Lax, 2->Strict; Chrome epoch conversion (us-11644473600000000)/1e6; __Host- cookies need url form with path / and no domain; partitionKey is now an object {topLevelSite, hasCrossSiteAncestor}. Network.setCookie(s) on the view's page target is the fallback if CEF's per-request-context browserContextId mapping is unclear (probe 5).
session_import.profile_copy_verdict: Rejected: Chromium downgrade handling migrates/razes newer-profile data (user_data_downgrade.cc), per-DB meta version gates can raze cookie stores, Secure Preferences MACs bind to profile path/machine, and live LevelDB/SQLite copies can tear. Only the Cookies file (+journal) is ever read, and only from disk copies.
session_import.transferability: No transfer success rate is established by this survey. W4 must report logged-in, challenged, partial and failed outcomes for the actual source/target pair.
security_constraints: Importer/control APIs expose allowlisted metadata, never raw credentials, credential headers or derived keys. This is not universal redaction of arbitrary page DOM/pixels.
Consent precedes protected-store access and identifies source profile, selected origins and destination view. No silent re-import; revocation/destruction must be qualified.
V1 uses in-memory imported-credential contexts. Engine processes necessarily receive credentials; W4 must verify no persistent credential store and test cookie/storage/worker isolation.
Raw eval/CDP and arbitrary userscripts are unavailable in v1. Managed snapshot/network output and approval decisions need their own bounded allowlists and current-target validation.
empirical_probes_for_w4: Keychain ACL probe under lapis's own code signing: dialog text, Always-Allow flow, deny-path OSStatus, per-browser service names.
Schema check on a disk copy of installed Chrome: meta version 24 plus v24 columns, no keychain needed.
v10 decryption round-trip: assert v10 prefix, plaintext[0:32] == sha256(host_key), strip; settles any Chrome 15x macOS encryption change empirically.
Live-read copy-vs-backup timing and row-count parity with the browser running (Chrome rollback-journal; Firefox WAL).
CEF 154 injection drill: Storage.setCookies with browserContextId, read-back, first-request authentication check, and whether each CefRequestContext maps to a distinct browserContextId.
Safari container read from non-FDA and FDA contexts to record the TCC boundary; per-profile cookie file enumeration.
Chrome 136 default-profile debug lockout reproduction (documents the CDP-export dead end).
local_verifications_2026_09_29: Chrome Default/Cookies exists; Cookies-journal present, no -wal.
Safari legacy ~/Library/Cookies/Cookies.binarycookies absent; container path present per the research stream's existence check.

unverified_or_open: CEF macOS arm64 installed size and per-view memory: compressed size verified; installed footprint and 32-view cost need the W0/W5 measurements.

IOSurface import into the desktop's Vulkan/MoltenVK scene graph: unproven in this configuration; installed Qt native Metal/Vulkan texture declarations were verified September 30, but zero-copy interop still requires W0 runtime proof.
CDP Storage/DOMStorage domain transition: re-pin against the pinned CEF at W4.
Imported-session transferability under TLS/UA fingerprint binding: an empirical rate to measure in W4.

review_corrections.independent_review: FlashX read-only review: service-birth, identity, isolation/SPA and raw-debug/credential contradictions; pin/isolation evidence and priority wording also repaired.

primary_source.observation: ExecuteDevToolsMethod and AddDevToolsMessageObserver explicitly do not require an active DevTools frontend or remote-debugging session. Declarations only, not runtime proof.

additional_contracts: Keep remote-debugging TCP disabled; session/view capabilities add actor binding beyond peer UID.
One view close does not stop the shared engine; GUI and service restart have distinct semantics.
Streaming events use NDJSON envelopes; approval tokens bind document, target and action.
Preview-only views differ from fully hidden views; idle resource cost remains measured.
Filesystem commands bind approved roots and opened descriptors; traversal/symlink/overwrite and post-approval changes are explicit W1/W3 cases.
review_corrections.limits: Documentation and metadata/header review only. No CEF archive/runtime, browser profile, credential values, Keychain grant or native UI accessed in this review.

local_header_observation.scope: Installed declarations only; no import, frame or GPU experiment performed.
